description: Align 2016/cryptanalysis predicate signatures with the model's actual round-column-byte array layout.
rationale: Modern MiniZinc rejects the old predicate declarations because the top-level arrays are indexed as [round, column, byte] while several local predicate signatures still declare them as [round, byte, column] or truncate the round range.

replacements.pattern: predicate ARK(array[0..n-2,0..3,0..BC-1] of var 0..1: DY, array[0..n-1,0..3,0..BC-1] of var 0..1: DK, array[0..n-1,0..3,0..BC-1] of var 0..1: DX ) =
replacements.replacement: predicate ARK(array[0..n-2,0..BC-1,0..3] of var 0..1: DY, array[0..n-1,0..BC-1,0..3] of var 0..1: DK, array[0..n-1,0..BC-1,0..3] of var 0..1: DX ) =

replacements.pattern: predicate SR(array[0..n-1,0..3,0..BC-1] of var 0..1: DX,array[0..n-2,0..3,0..BC-1] of var 0..1: DSR) =
replacements.replacement: predicate SR(array[0..n-1,0..BC-1,0..3] of var 0..1: DX,array[0..n-1,0..BC-1,0..3] of var 0..1: DSR) =

replacements.pattern: predicate MC(array[0..n-1,0..BC-1] of var 0..4: CSRX,array[0..n-2,0..3,0..BC-1] of var 0..1: DY) =
replacements.replacement: predicate MC(array[0..n-1,0..BC-1] of var 0..4: CSRX,array[0..n-2,0..BC-1,0..3] of var 0..1: DY) =

replacements.pattern: predicate KS(array[0..n-1,0..3,0..BC-1] of var 0..1: DK, array[0..n-1,0..BC-1,0..3, 0..NBK-1] of var 0..1: Kcomp, array[0..3,0..n-1,0..BC-1,0..n-1,0..BC-1] of var 0..1: EQ
replacements.replacement: predicate KS(array[0..n-1,0..BC-1,0..3] of var 0..1: DK, array[0..n-1,0..BC-1,0..3, 0..NBK-1] of var 0..1: Kcomp, array[0..3,0..n-1,0..BC-1,0..n-1,0..BC-1] of var 0..1: EQ

replacements.pattern: predicate linearMC(array[0..n-2,0..3,0..BC-1] of var 0..1: DY, array[0..n-1,0..3,0..BC-1] of var 0..1: DK, array[0..n-1,0..3,0..BC-1] of var 0..1: DX, array[0..n-1,0..3,0..BC-1] of var 0..1: DSR, array[0..3,0..n-1,0..BC-1,0..n-1,0..BC-1] of var 0..1: EQ, array[0..n-1,0..BC-1] of var 0..4: CSRX) =
replacements.replacement: predicate linearMC(array[0..n-2,0..BC-1,0..3] of var 0..1: DY, array[0..n-1,0..BC-1,0..3] of var 0..1: DK, array[0..n-1,0..BC-1,0..3] of var 0..1: DX, array[0..n-1,0..BC-1,0..3] of var 0..1: DSR, array[0..3,0..n-1,0..BC-1,0..n-1,0..BC-1] of var 0..1: EQ, array[0..n-1,0..BC-1] of var 0..4: CSRX) =

semantics_note: This patch does not change the model equations; it only makes local predicate signatures consistent with the arrays they are called with.
